outline:
土木專題特論乃透過國際學者的講課，讓學生學習土木相關領域的重要知識及了解最先進之研究成果或最新開發成品。
This course will provide important knowledge and information regarding to the latest development or application on the field of civil engineering. Speakers being invited are well-known international scholars in the related area.
schedule:
FRP Composite Materials Week 1~2
Retrofit of RC Structures using CFRP Week 3~6
Student presentation Week 7~9
FRP members for Construction Week 10~12
Fiber-Reinforced Concrete in Civil Eng Week 12~15
Student presentation Week 16~18
